tool_schemas.name: get_steam_trending_games
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent (or requested) Steam “trending” snapshot entries, ordered by rank, and pages results using the opaque cursor with up to limit items per page (response includes a next cursor when more results exist). Validates limit bounds, cursor format, captured_after as an RFC 3339 date-time, and snapshot_id against the required gtm_snp_… pattern. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/ FORBIDDEN when access is not permitted, NOT_FOUND when snapshot_id does not exist, and BAD_REQUEST when snapshot_id is provided together with other snapshot filters or when any parameter fails validation.

limit.description: Maximum number of games to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

captured_after.description: Only return data from snapshots captured at or after this time.

snapshot_id.description: Return items from a specific trend snapshot id.

tool_schemas.name: get_epic_free_games
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent (or requested) Epic Games Store free-game promotion snapshot entries and pages results using the opaque cursor with up to limit items per page (response includes a next cursor when more results exist); include_upcoming controls whether future-starting promotions are included. Validates limit bounds, cursor format, captured_after as an RFC 3339 date-time, snapshot_id against the required gtm_snp_… pattern, and include_upcoming as boolean. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/ FORBIDDEN when access is not permitted, NOT_FOUND when snapshot_id does not exist, and BAD_REQUEST when snapshot_id is provided together with other snapshot filters or when any parameter fails validation.

limit.description: Maximum number of games/promotions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

captured_after.description: Only return data from snapshots captured at or after this time.

snapshot_id.description: Return items from a specific trend snapshot id.

include_upcoming.description: Whether to include items whose promo starts in the future.

limit.description: Maximum number of games to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_all_trending_games
tool_schemas.description: Returns trend list entries across Steam and/or Epic for the requested list_type and platform, and pages results using the opaque cursor with up to limit items per page (response includes a next cursor when more results exist). Validates platform and list_type enums, limit bounds, cursor format, and captured_after as an RFC 3339 date-time; requests where platform and list_type are incompatible (e.g., platform=steam with list_type=epic_free_games) are rejected. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/ FORBIDDEN when access is not permitted and BAD_REQUEST when any parameter fails validation or an incompatible platform/list_type combination is provided.

list_type.description: Which list to return; use all to include every list type.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

captured_after.description: Only return data from snapshots captured at or after this time.

tool_schemas.name: get_api_health
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current API health summary and, when include_details is true, includes the full set of underlying health-check results used to compute the status. Validates include_details as boolean. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/ FORBIDDEN when access is not permitted and BAD_REQUEST when the parameter fails validation.

include_details.description: Whether to include the full health check details object.

tool_schemas.name: list_games
tool_schemas.description: Lists normalized game catalog entries with optional filters and cursor pagination. Returns games ordered by updated_at desc by default. Validates filter formats and refuses invalid combinations (e.g., merged_into_game_id without status='merged'). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks read scope.

limit.description: Maximum number of games to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

query.description: Case-insensitive search over canonical_title and slug.

primary_platform.description: Filter by the game’s primary platform.

merged_into_game_id.description: Filter games that were merged into the specified canonical game id (only meaningful when status='merged').

updated_after.description: Only return games updated at or after this time (RFC 3339).

tool_schemas.name: get_game
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single normalized game by id. Returns the game record or NOT_FOUND when the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks read scope.

tool_schemas.name: update_game
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a normalized game and can drive allowed lifecycle transitions via status. Refuses invalid transitions (e.g., merged -> active) and refuses setting status='merged' without merged_into_game_id. Returns the updated game. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks write scope.

canonical_title.description: Canonical display title for the game.

slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the canonical title.

primary_platform.description: Primary platform used for canonical store URL and de-duplication.

steam_app_id.description: Steam app id for this game, if applicable.

epic_offer_id.description: Epic offer id for this game, if applicable.

merged_into_game_id.description: When status='merged', points to the canonical game id this entry was merged into.

tool_schemas.name: list_trend_snapshots
tool_schemas.description: Lists trend snapshots with filtering by platform/list_type/status and cursor pagination. Returns snapshots ordered by captured_at desc. Refuses invalid enum values and refuses unknown list_type for a platform. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks read scope.

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

captured_after.description: Only return snapshots captured at or after this time (RFC 3339).

captured_before.description: Only return snapshots captured before this time (RFC 3339).

metadata.name: Game Trends
metadata.description: This backend stores periodically refreshed snapshots of trending/top-selling/most-played game lists from Steam and Epic, plus normalized game catalog entries used to de-duplicate titles across sources. It also stores ingestion job runs and API health check results so the service can report freshness
